scenes.sentence: The suspect was accused of abducting the young girl from her home.
scenes.translation: 嫌疑人被指控从家中绑架了那个小女孩。

scenes.sentence: He faced life imprisonment for abducting and harming two children.
scenes.translation: 他因绑架并伤害两名儿童而面临终身监禁。

scenes.sentence: I am able to finish the homework by myself.
scenes.translation: 我能独立完成作业。

scenes.sentence: She was able to run very fast in the race.
scenes.translation: 她在比赛中跑得很快。

scenes.sentence: They left their abode early in the morning to catch the train.
scenes.translation: 他们一大早就离开了住所去赶火车。

scenes.sentence: The old cottage served as a temporary abode for the travelers.
scenes.translation: 那座老小屋曾作为旅行者的临时住所。

nodes.name: above
nodes.meaning: prep. 在……上面；超过；adj. 上面的；高尚的；adv. 在上面；以上

scenes.sentence: The bird is flying above the trees.
scenes.translation: 鸟在树上方飞翔。

scenes.sentence: People above the age of 60 can get a discount.
scenes.translation: 60岁以上的人可以获得折扣。

scenes.sentence: He is above such petty arguments.
scenes.translation: 他不屑于这种琐碎的争论。

nodes.name: abrupt
nodes.meaning: adj. 突然的；陡峭的；唐突的

scenes.scene: 描述天气或情况的突然变化
scenes.sentence: The weather took an abrupt turn, and the sunshine vanished instantly.
scenes.translation: 天气突然变了，阳光瞬间消失。

scenes.scene: 描述行为的无礼或唐突
scenes.sentence: He made an abrupt remark that offended everyone at the table.
scenes.translation: 他说了句唐突的话，冒犯了在座的每个人。

nodes.name: absent-minded
nodes.meaning: adj. 心不在焉的；神不守舍的

scenes.sentence: Due to being absent-minded, he forgot to lock the door when he left.
scenes.translation: 由于心不在焉，他离开时忘了锁门。

scenes.sentence: The absent-minded professor walked into the wrong classroom.
scenes.translation: 那位心不在焉的教授走进了错误的教室。

nodes.name: absolute
nodes.meaning: adj. 绝对的；完全的；纯粹的

scenes.sentence: There is no absolute truth in this matter.
scenes.translation: 这件事没有绝对的真理。

scenes.scene: 表达绝对的信心或控制
scenes.sentence: She has absolute confidence in her team.
scenes.translation: 她对自己的团队有着绝对的信心。

scenes.sentence: I absolutely love this song.
scenes.translation: 我绝对喜欢这首歌。

scenes.sentence: The results were absolutely stunning.
scenes.translation: 结果令人惊叹。

nodes.name: absorbing
nodes.meaning: adj. 吸引人的；令人全神贯注的

scenes.scene: 描述一本引人入胜的书
scenes.sentence: The documentary was so absorbing that I didn't notice the time passing.
scenes.translation: 这部纪录片太引人入胜了，我都没注意到时间的流逝。

scenes.sentence: He found the puzzle completely absorbing and spent hours solving it.
scenes.translation: 他觉得这个谜题完全令人着迷，花了几个小时才解开。

nodes.name: abstract
nodes.meaning: adj. 抽象的；n. 摘要；v. 提取，摘录

scenes.sentence: The concept of justice is highly abstract and difficult to define precisely.
scenes.translation: 正义的概念非常抽象，很难精确定义。

scenes.sentence: Please write a brief abstract for your research paper before submission.
scenes.translation: 请在提交论文之前写一份简短的摘要。

scenes.sentence: It is absolutely absurd to blame her for the accident.
scenes.translation: 把事故怪在她头上是绝对荒谬的。

scenes.sentence: The theory lacks empirical evidence and seems logically absurd.
scenes.translation: 该理论缺乏实证支持，且在逻辑上显得荒谬。

nodes.name: academic
nodes.meaning: adj. 学术的；学院的；理论的 n. 学者；大学教师

scenes.sentence: The academic performance of the students has improved significantly this semester.
scenes.translation: 这学期学生的学术表现有了显著提高。

scenes.sentence: His knowledge is purely academic and lacks practical application.
scenes.translation: 他的知识纯粹是理论上的，缺乏实际应用。

scenes.sentence: I have to accept the fact that I made a mistake.
scenes.translation: 我必须接受我犯了一个错误的事实。

scenes.sentence: She politely accepted the invitation to the party.
scenes.translation: 她礼貌地接受了聚会的邀请。

scenes.sentence: The bank will accept your check after verification.
scenes.translation: 银行核实后将接受您的支票。

nodes.name: access
nodes.meaning: n. 通道；进入；使用权 v. 访问；获取

scenes.sentence: Students need a password to access the library database.
scenes.translation: 学生需要密码才能访问图书馆数据库。

scenes.sentence: The only access to the village is by a narrow road.
scenes.translation: 进入该村庄的唯一通道是一条狭窄的道路。

scenes.sentence: Education is a basic human right and should be accessible to everyone.
scenes.translation: 教育是一项基本人权，应该对每个人开放。

scenes.sentence: He was injured in a car accident last week.
scenes.translation: 他上周在一场车祸中受伤。

scenes.sentence: It was just an accident, I didn't mean to break it.
scenes.translation: 这只是一个意外，我不是故意打碎它的。

nodes.name: acclaimed
nodes.meaning: adj. 受到赞扬的；获大奖的

scenes.sentence: The acclaimed novel has been adapted into a successful film.
scenes.translation: 这部备受赞誉的小说已被改编成一部成功的电影。

scenes.sentence: She is an acclaimed actress known for her powerful performances.
scenes.translation: 她是一位备受赞誉的女演员，以其强有力的表演而闻名。

scenes.sentence: The police arrested the accomplice for his role in the bank robbery.
scenes.translation: 警察逮捕了这名共犯，因为他在银行抢劫案中起了作用。

scenes.sentence: He was charged as an accomplice to the crime, though he did not commit it himself.
scenes.translation: 他被指控为犯罪的共犯，尽管他自己没有实施犯罪。

scenes.sentence: She worked hard to accomplish her goal of passing the BEC exam.
scenes.translation: 她努力工作以实现通过BEC考试的目标。

scenes.sentence: The team managed to accomplish the project ahead of schedule.
scenes.translation: 团队设法提前完成了项目。

nodes.name: accomplished
nodes.meaning: adj. 有造诣的；熟练的；已完成的

scenes.scene: 描述艺术家的专业技能
scenes.sentence: She is an accomplished pianist who has performed in major concert halls.
scenes.translation: 她是一位造诣深厚的钢琴家，曾在主要音乐厅演出。

scenes.scene: 描述完成某项复杂任务
scenes.sentence: The team delivered an accomplished solution to the complex engineering problem.
scenes.translation: 团队为解决这个复杂的工程问题提供了一个成熟的方案。

nodes.name: account
nodes.meaning: n. 账户；描述；账目 v. 说明；占据；认为

scenes.sentence: I need to check my bank account balance.
scenes.translation: 我需要检查我的银行账户余额。

scenes.sentence: The company will account for the missing funds in the next report.
scenes.translation: 公司将在下一份报告中说明缺失的资金。

scenes.sentence: The suspect was accused of stealing the jewelry.
scenes.translation: 嫌疑人被指控盗窃珠宝。

scenes.sentence: Don't accuse me of lying when you haven't heard the truth.
scenes.translation: 没听真话之前别指责我撒谎。

scenes.sentence: My head aches because I didn't sleep well last night.
scenes.translation: 我头疼，因为昨晚没睡好。

scenes.sentence: I ache to see my family after such a long time.
scenes.translation: 这么久没见，我渴望见到我的家人。

scenes.sentence: She worked hard to achieve her goal of getting into a top university.
scenes.translation: 她努力学习以实现进入顶尖大学的目标。

scenes.sentence: He achieved great success in his career as an engineer.
scenes.translation: 他在工程师的职业道路上取得了巨大的成功。

scenes.sentence: Winning the competition was a great achievement for the young student.
scenes.translation: 赢得比赛对这个年轻学生来说是一项巨大的成就。

scenes.sentence: Her latest achievement in the field of technology has gained widespread recognition.
scenes.translation: 她在科技领域的最新成就获得了广泛的认可。

nodes.name: acknowledge
nodes.meaning: v. 承认；致谢；确认收到

scenes.sentence: He finally acknowledged that he was wrong.
scenes.translation: 他终于承认他错了。

scenes.sentence: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
scenes.translation: 请确认收到此邮件。

scenes.sentence: The author acknowledged the help of her colleagues in the book.
scenes.translation: 作者在书中感谢了同事们的帮助。

scenes.sentence: The acoustics of the concert hall were designed to enhance the clarity of the symphony.
scenes.translation: 音乐厅的声学设计旨在提升交响乐的清晰度。

scenes.sentence: We need to check the acoustics in the meeting room before the presentation.
scenes.translation: 在演示之前，我们需要检查会议室的音响效果。

scenes.sentence: He is merely an acquaintance, not a close friend.
scenes.translation: 他只是个熟人，不是密友。

scenes.sentence: She has a good acquaintance with the local customs.
scenes.translation: 她对当地风俗很熟悉。

nodes.name: acquit
nodes.meaning: v. 宣告……无罪；使免除（责任、义务等）

scenes.sentence: The jury decided to acquit the defendant due to lack of evidence.
scenes.translation: 由于缺乏证据，陪审团决定宣告被告无罪。

scenes.sentence: He was acquitted of all charges after the investigation concluded.
scenes.translation: 调查结束后，他被免除了所有指控。

scenes.sentence: It's time to take action and solve the problem.
scenes.translation: 是时候采取行动解决问题了。

scenes.sentence: The government needs to take immediate action to protect the environment.
scenes.translation: 政府需要立即采取行动保护环境。

scenes.sentence: His actions were considered illegal by the police.
scenes.translation: 他的行为被警方视为非法。

nodes.name: active
nodes.meaning: adj. 积极的；活跃的；主动的

scenes.sentence: Tom is an active student in class.
scenes.translation: 汤姆是班里一个积极的学生。

scenes.sentence: She leads an active lifestyle.
scenes.translation: 她过着活跃的生活方式。

scenes.sentence: The school offers a wide variety of after-school activities to help students develop new skills.
scenes.translation: 学校提供多种多样的课后活动，帮助学生培养新技能。

scenes.sentence: We have scheduled several outdoor activities for the weekend, including hiking and kayaking.
scenes.translation: 我们为周末安排了几个户外活动，包括徒步旅行和皮划艇。

scenes.sentence: Regular physical activity is essential for maintaining good health and preventing diseases.
scenes.translation: 规律的体力活动对于保持健康和预防疾病至关重要。

nodes.name: ad
nodes.meaning: abbr. 广告 (advertisement); 前任 (advisory director)

scenes.sentence: I saw an ad for a new smartphone in the newspaper.
scenes.translation: 我在报纸上看到了一个新款智能手机的广告。

scenes.sentence: She clicked on the online ad to buy the shoes.
scenes.translation: 她点击了网络广告去买那双鞋。

scenes.sentence: Addition is the first arithmetic operation that children learn in primary school.
scenes.translation: 加法是孩子们在小学学习的第一种算术运算。

scenes.sentence: The addition of new features to the software significantly improved user satisfaction.
scenes.translation: 向软件添加新功能显著提高了用户满意度。

scenes.sentence: In addition to English, she speaks French and Spanish fluently.
scenes.translation: 除了英语，她还能流利说法语和西班牙语。

nodes.name: address
nodes.meaning: v. 处理；解决；向…致辞 n. 地址；演讲

scenes.sentence: We need to address the issue of climate change immediately.
scenes.translation: 我们需要立即处理气候变化的问题。

scenes.sentence: The president delivered an address to the nation on television.
scenes.translation: 总统在电视上向全国发表了讲话。

scenes.sentence: Please ensure that your return address is correct on the envelope.
scenes.translation: 请确保信封上的回邮地址正确无误。

scenes.sentence: The addressee should verify the authenticity of the document before signing.
scenes.translation: 收件人在签署之前应验证文件的真实性。

scenes.sentence: Any notice sent to the addressee at the specified address shall be deemed received.
scenes.translation: 发送至指定地址收件人的任何通知均视为已收到。

scenes.sentence: The company made a slight adjustment to the pricing strategy to accommodate market fluctuations.
scenes.translation: 公司为适应市场波动对定价策略进行了微调。

scenes.sentence: It took him several months to make the necessary adjustments to his new working environment.
scenes.translation: 他花了几个月时间才对新工作环境做出必要的适应。

nodes.name: administrator
nodes.meaning: n. 管理员；行政人员；受托人

scenes.sentence: The school administrator announced the new schedule for the upcoming exam week.
scenes.translation: 学校管理员宣布了即将到来的考试周的新时间表。

scenes.sentence: You need the administrator password to install this software on your computer.
scenes.translation: 你需要管理员密码才能在这台电脑上安装这个软件。

scenes.sentence: The court appointed an administrator to manage the estate of the deceased.
scenes.translation: 法院指定了一名管理员来处理死者的遗产。

scenes.sentence: I really admire your courage to speak up.
scenes.translation: 我真的很钦佩你敢于直言的勇气。

scenes.sentence: She admires her mentor for his professional expertise.
scenes.translation: 她钦佩导师的专业知识。

scenes.sentence: The researcher had to admit that the initial hypothesis was flawed.
scenes.translation: 研究人员不得不承认最初的假设是有缺陷的。

scenes.sentence: You must admit that he is a very talented musician.
scenes.translation: 你必须承认他是一位非常有才华的音乐家。

scenes.scene: 学术讨论中承认局限性
scenes.sentence: Admittedly, the sample size was relatively small, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
scenes.translation: 诚然，样本量相对较小，这可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。

scenes.sentence: Admittedly, the proposal has some flaws, but it is still the most viable option available.
scenes.translation: 不可否认，这个提案有一些缺陷，但它仍然是目前最可行的选择。

scenes.sentence: The transition from adolescence to adulthood can be a challenging period for many young people.
scenes.translation: 从青春期到成年的过渡对许多年轻人来说可能是一个充满挑战的时期。

scenes.sentence: Entering adulthood means taking on more financial and social responsibilities.
scenes.translation: 进入成年意味着承担更多的经济和社会责任。

nodes.name: advance
nodes.meaning: v. 前进；促进；预付 n. 前进；进展；预付款

scenes.sentence: She made rapid advance in her English studies this semester.
scenes.translation: 这学期她的英语学习取得了迅速进步。

scenes.sentence: The company asked for an advance on his salary.
scenes.translation: 公司要求预支他的工资。

nodes.name: adventurous
nodes.meaning: adj. 爱冒险的；大胆的；充满风险的

scenes.sentence: He is an adventurous traveler who loves exploring remote jungles.
scenes.translation: 他是一个爱冒险的旅行者，喜欢探索偏远的丛林。

scenes.sentence: She is adventurous enough to try spicy insects at the local market.
scenes.translation: 她足够大胆，敢在当地市场尝试辛辣的昆虫。

scenes.sentence: The company advertises its new product on social media.
scenes.translation: 公司在社交媒体上为其新产品做广告

scenes.sentence: They decided to advertise in the local newspaper to reach more customers.
scenes.translation: 他们决定在当地报纸上刊登广告以接触更多顾客

scenes.sentence: The company plans to advertise its new product on social media platforms.
scenes.translation: 该公司计划在社交媒体平台上为其新产品做广告。

scenes.sentence: He advertised his old bicycle on the internet to sell it quickly.
scenes.translation: 他在网上登广告卖他的旧自行车，想快点卖掉。

scenes.sentence: I saw an advertisement for a new smartphone on the bus.
scenes.translation: 我在公交车上看到了一个新款智能手机的广告。

scenes.sentence: The company spent a lot of money on television advertisements last year.
scenes.translation: 去年公司在电视广告上花了很多钱。

scenes.sentence: The advertiser decided to increase the budget for digital marketing.
scenes.translation: 广告商决定增加数字营销的预算。

scenes.sentence: Local advertisers are facing challenges due to the rise of online platforms.
scenes.translation: 由于在线平台的兴起，本地广告商正面临挑战。

scenes.sentence: Can you give me some advice on how to prepare for the exam?
scenes.translation: 你能给我一些关于如何准备考试的建议吗？

scenes.sentence: The doctor's advice was to get more rest and drink plenty of water.
scenes.translation: 医生的建议是多休息并多喝水。

scenes.sentence: The weather can affect our mood.
scenes.translation: 天气会影响我们的情绪。

scenes.sentence: Did the rain affect your journey to school?
scenes.translation: 雨影响你上学了吗？

scenes.sentence: She has a great affection for her younger brother.
scenes.translation: 她非常疼爱她的弟弟。

scenes.sentence: His affection for her was evident in the way he looked at her.
scenes.translation: 他对她的爱意在他注视她的方式中显露无遗。

nodes.name: affectionate
nodes.meaning: adj. 深情的，充满爱意的

scenes.scene: 描述家庭成员间的亲密关系
scenes.sentence: She gave her daughter an affectionate hug before leaving for work.
scenes.translation: 上班前，她给了女儿一个充满爱意的拥抱。

scenes.scene: 描述宠物与主人的互动
scenes.sentence: The affectionate dog greeted its owner by wagging its tail vigorously.
scenes.translation: 那只深情的狗通过剧烈摇尾巴来迎接主人。

nodes.name: African-Caribbean
nodes.meaning: adj. 非洲裔加勒比人的 n. 非洲裔加勒比人

scenes.sentence: The African-Caribbean community in London has a vibrant cultural heritage that influences local music and cuisine.
scenes.translation: 伦敦的非洲裔加勒比社区拥有充满活力的文化遗产，影响着当地的音乐和美食。

scenes.sentence: Many African-Caribbean families have lived in the UK for several generations, contributing significantly to society.
scenes.translation: 许多非洲裔加勒比家庭在英国生活了几代人，为社会做出了重大贡献。

nodes.name: after
nodes.meaning: prep. 在……以后; conj. 在……之后

scenes.sentence: We will go for a walk after dinner.
scenes.translation: 晚饭后我们将去散步。

scenes.sentence: He worked as a teacher after graduation.
scenes.translation: 毕业后他做了一名老师。

nodes.name: against
nodes.meaning: prep. 对着，反对；倚靠；防止

scenes.sentence: He leaned against the wall.
scenes.translation: 他靠在墙上。

scenes.sentence: I am against the plan.
scenes.translation: 我反对这个计划。

scenes.sentence: The vaccine protects against the virus.
scenes.translation: 疫苗可以预防病毒。

scenes.sentence: How old are you?
scenes.translation: 你多大了？

scenes.sentence: In ancient times, people lived for a short age.
scenes.translation: 在古代，人的寿命很短。

scenes.sentence: The rapidly ageing population poses significant challenges to the healthcare system.
scenes.translation: 迅速老龄化的人口给医疗系统带来了重大挑战。

scenes.sentence: He is approaching the age of retirement and is preparing for a quieter life.
scenes.translation: 他正接近退休年龄，正在为更安静的生活做准备。

nodes.name: aggressive
nodes.meaning: adj. 好斗的；有进取心的；侵略性的

scenes.sentence: She is known for her aggressive approach to sales, which has significantly increased the company's revenue.
scenes.translation: 她以进取的销售方式著称，这显著增加了公司的收入。

scenes.sentence: The driver's aggressive behavior on the road led to a serious traffic accident.
scenes.translation: 司机在路上的攻击性行为导致了一起严重的交通事故。

scenes.sentence: The political agitation in the capital led to a temporary curfew.
scenes.translation: 首都的政治骚动导致实施临时宵禁。

scenes.sentence: She felt a growing sense of agitation as the exam results were announced.
scenes.translation: 随着考试成绩的公布，她感到焦虑感日益增强。

nodes.name: aid
nodes.meaning: n. 援助; v. 帮助

scenes.sentence: The rescue team provided medical aid to the injured.
scenes.translation: 救援队为受伤者提供了医疗援助。

scenes.sentence: Can you give me a hand with this heavy box?
scenes.translation: 你能帮我搬这个重箱子吗？

scenes.sentence: The government sent aid to the flood victims.
scenes.translation: 政府向洪水受害者提供了援助。

scenes.sentence: The government launched a campaign to raise awareness about AIDS prevention.
scenes.translation: 政府发起了一项提高艾滋病预防意识的活动。

scenes.sentence: Early detection of AIDS can significantly improve the quality of life for patients.
scenes.translation: 早期发现艾滋病可以显著提高患者的生活质量。

nodes.name: aim
nodes.meaning: v. 旨在；瞄准 n. 目标

scenes.sentence: The aim of this study is to explore the impact of social media on teenagers.
scenes.translation: 这项研究的目的是探索社交媒体对青少年的影响。

scenes.sentence: He aimed to finish the project before the weekend.
scenes.translation: 他的目标是在周末之前完成这个项目。

nodes.name: air
nodes.meaning: n. 空气；空间；天空 v. 通风；使显露

scenes.sentence: The air is fresh after the rain.
scenes.translation: 雨后空气很清新。

scenes.sentence: Let's open the window to let some air in.
scenes.translation: 我们打开窗户透透气吧。

scenes.sentence: We booked a quiet, air-conditioned room for our stay.
scenes.translation: 我们预订了一间安静的带空调的房间入住。

scenes.sentence: The bus was hot and stuffy because the air-conditioning was broken.
scenes.translation: 公共汽车又热又闷，因为空调坏了。

scenes.sentence: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
scenes.translation: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达机场。

scenes.sentence: He suffered from airsickness during the long flight.
scenes.translation: 他在漫长的飞行中遭受了晕机的痛苦。

scenes.sentence: She took some medicine to prevent airsickness before boarding.
scenes.translation: 她在登机前服了一些药以防止晕机。

nodes.name: AKA
nodes.meaning: abbr. 又名，也就是（also known as）

scenes.sentence: He is a famous singer, aka The King.
scenes.translation: 他是一位著名的歌手，也就是“国王”。

scenes.sentence: My online friend, aka Mike, lives in London.
scenes.translation: 我的网友，也就是迈克，住在伦敦。

scenes.sentence: I showed my friends my new photo album.
scenes.translation: 我向朋友们展示了我的新相册。

scenes.sentence: The singer released a new album last week.
scenes.translation: 那位歌手上周发行了一张新专辑。

nodes.name: alight
nodes.meaning: v. 下车；降落；点燃 adj. 燃烧的；发光的

scenes.sentence: Passengers alighted from the bus at the final stop.
scenes.translation: 乘客们在终点站下了公交车。

scenes.sentence: A butterfly alighted gently on the flower.
scenes.translation: 一只蝴蝶轻轻地落在花朵上。

scenes.sentence: The room was alight with candles, creating a warm atmosphere.
scenes.translation: 房间里点满了蜡烛，营造出温暖的氛围。

nodes.name: alive
nodes.meaning: adj. 活着的；活泼的；继续存在的

scenes.sentence: The patient is still alive after the surgery.
scenes.translation: 手术后病人仍然活着。

scenes.sentence: The tradition is still alive in this village.
scenes.translation: 这个传统在这个村庄里仍然存续。

scenes.sentence: The party was alive with music and laughter.
scenes.translation: 派对上充满了音乐和欢笑，气氛热烈。

scenes.sentence: The company needs to allocate more resources to the marketing department.
scenes.translation: 公司需要向市场部门分配更多资源。

scenes.sentence: You should allocate specific time slots for studying each subject.
scenes.translation: 你应该为每门学科分配特定的学习时间。

nodes.name: all-out
nodes.meaning: adj. 全力的；彻底的；全力以赴的

scenes.sentence: The team launched an all-out attack in the final minutes to win the championship.
scenes.translation: 球队在最后几分钟发动了全力以赴的进攻，以赢得冠军。

scenes.sentence: She made an all-out effort to recover from the injury and return to work.
scenes.translation: 她全力以赴地努力从伤病中恢复并重返工作岗位。

nodes.name: allowance
nodes.meaning: n. 津贴，补贴；零用钱；限额

scenes.sentence: My parents give me a monthly allowance to cover my personal expenses.
scenes.translation: 父母每月给我零花钱以支付我的个人开销。

scenes.sentence: Employees are entitled to a housing allowance if they live more than 20 miles from the office.
scenes.translation: 如果员工居住在距离办公室20英里以外，他们有权获得住房津贴。

scenes.sentence: There is a strict allowance for the amount of luggage you can bring on the flight.
scenes.translation: 你对此次航班可携带的行李量有严格的限额。

scenes.sentence: She worked alongside her colleagues to finish the project.
scenes.translation: 她和同事一起工作完成了这个项目。

scenes.sentence: The car was parked alongside the curb.
scenes.translation: 汽车停在路缘石旁边。

scenes.sentence: The teacher asked the student to read the story aloud to the class.
scenes.translation: 老师要求那个学生把故事大声读给全班听。

scenes.sentence: He was talking aloud to himself while walking in the park.
scenes.translation: 他在公园里散步时大声自言自语。

scenes.sentence: Although it was raining, we still went out for a walk.
scenes.translation: 虽然下着雨，但我们还是出去散步了。

scenes.sentence: Although he was tired, he finished his homework on time.
scenes.translation: 虽然他很累，但他按时完成了作业。

scenes.sentence: The ambassador presented his credentials to the president.
scenes.translation: 大使向总统递交了国书。

scenes.sentence: Her ambition is to become a doctor.
scenes.translation: 她的志向是成为一名医生。

scenes.sentence: He has no ambition to climb the corporate ladder.
scenes.translation: 他没有爬上公司权力顶峰的野心。

scenes.sentence: Ambition is the spark that lights the fire of success.
scenes.translation: 抱负是点燃成功之火的火花。

nodes.name: ambitious
nodes.meaning: adj. 有雄心的；野心勃勃的

scenes.sentence: She is an ambitious manager who always strives for promotion.
scenes.translation: 她是一位有雄心的经理，总是努力争取晋升。

scenes.sentence: His ambitious plan to expand the business faced many challenges.
scenes.translation: 他扩大业务的雄心勃勃的计划面临许多挑战。

scenes.sentence: She sat among her friends.
scenes.translation: 她坐在朋友们中间。

scenes.sentence: There is a big tree among the flowers.
scenes.translation: 花朵中间有一棵大树。

nodes.name: amount
nodes.meaning: v. 总计；相当于 n. 数量

scenes.sentence: The total amount of money we spent was quite large.
scenes.translation: 我们花费的总金额相当大。

scenes.sentence: Please verify the amount of the invoice before payment.
scenes.translation: 付款前请核对发票金额。

scenes.sentence: The researcher decided to analyse the data collected from the survey.
scenes.translation: 研究人员决定分析从调查中收集的数据。

scenes.sentence: We need to analyse the situation before making a decision.
scenes.translation: 我们需要在做出决定之前分析局势。

scenes.sentence: He was filled with anger when he heard the news.
scenes.translation: 听到这个消息时，他充满了愤怒。

scenes.sentence: She controlled her anger and spoke calmly.
scenes.translation: 她控制住怒火，冷静地说话。

scenes.sentence: He twisted his ankle while playing basketball.
scenes.translation: 他在打篮球时扭伤了脚踝。

scenes.sentence: She wore a pair of high-heeled shoes that hurt her ankles.
scenes.translation: 她穿了一双让她脚踝疼痛的高跟鞋。

nodes.name: annoyance
nodes.meaning: n. 烦恼；令人讨厌的人或事

scenes.sentence: The constant noise from the construction site was a major annoyance to the residents.
scenes.translation: 建筑工地的持续噪音是居民们的一大烦恼。

scenes.sentence: Please ensure that this minor technical glitch does not cause any further annoyance to our clients.
scenes.translation: 请确保这个小的技术故障不会给客户端造成进一步的困扰。

scenes.sentence: He pulled his anorak tighter against the biting wind.
scenes.translation: 他把防寒连帽衣裹紧以抵御刺骨的寒风。

scenes.sentence: She wore a bright red anorak while hiking in the mountains.
scenes.translation: 她在山上徒步时穿着一件鲜红色的防寒连帽衣。

nodes.name: anorexic
nodes.meaning: adj. 厌食的，神经性厌食的 n. 厌食症患者

scenes.sentence: The patient was diagnosed with anorexic behavior after refusing to eat for several days.
scenes.translation: 这名患者因连续几天拒绝进食而被诊断为厌食行为。

scenes.sentence: She has an anorexic attitude towards food, which worries her family.
scenes.translation: 她对食物有厌食态度，这让她的家人很担心。

nodes.name: answer
nodes.meaning: v. 回答; 响应 n. 回答; 答案

scenes.sentence: Please answer the phone when it rings.
scenes.translation: 电话响时请接听。

scenes.sentence: You need to answer three questions correctly to pass the test.
scenes.translation: 你需要正确回答三个问题才能通过考试。

scenes.sentence: Antarctica is the southernmost continent on Earth.
scenes.translation: 南极洲是地球上最南端的大陆。

scenes.sentence: The climate in Antarctica is extremely cold and dry.
scenes.translation: 南极洲的气候极其寒冷且干燥。

scenes.sentence: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic to treat the bacterial infection.
scenes.translation: 医生开了抗生素来治疗细菌感染。

scenes.sentence: Overuse of antibiotics can lead to resistance.
scenes.translation: 过度使用抗生素会导致耐药性。

nodes.name: antisocial
nodes.meaning: adj. 反社会的；不合群的

scenes.sentence: He displayed antisocial behavior by avoiding all social gatherings.
scenes.translation: 他通过避免参加所有社交聚会表现出反社会行为。

scenes.sentence: Some people are naturally more antisocial and prefer solitude.
scenes.translation: 有些人天生更不合群，更喜欢独处。

scenes.sentence: The anti-war movement gained significant momentum during the Vietnam War.
scenes.translation: 反战运动在越南战争期间获得了巨大的势头。

scenes.sentence: She expressed her anti-war sentiments through her poetry.
scenes.translation: 她通过诗歌表达了她的反战情绪。

nodes.name: anxious
nodes.meaning: adj. 焦虑的；担心的；渴望的

scenes.sentence: Students often feel anxious before important exams.
scenes.translation: 学生在重要考试前经常感到焦虑。

scenes.sentence: She was anxious about her future career prospects.
scenes.translation: 她对未来职业前景感到担忧。

scenes.sentence: The children were anxious to open their Christmas presents.
scenes.translation: 孩子们迫不及待地想打开他们的圣诞礼物。

scenes.sentence: She waited anxiously for the exam results to be announced.
scenes.translation: 她焦虑地等待考试成绩公布。

scenes.sentence: His parents watched anxiously as he climbed the mountain.
scenes.translation: 当他爬上山时，他的父母焦虑地注视着。

nodes.name: anyway
nodes.meaning: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样；反正

scenes.scene: 日常对话中用于转换话题或表示不顾前文情况
scenes.sentence: It's raining, but we are going to the park anyway.
scenes.translation: 虽然下雨了，但我们无论如何还是要去公园。

scenes.sentence: You can try to change my mind, but I won't do it anyway.
scenes.translation: 你可以试着改变我的主意，但我反正不会那么做。

scenes.sentence: They are looking for a two-bedroom apartment near the university.
scenes.translation: 他们正在大学附近找一套两居室的公寓。

scenes.sentence: The apartment has a beautiful view of the city.
scenes.translation: 这套公寓拥有美丽的城市景观。

scenes.sentence: I downloaded a new app to track my exercise.
scenes.translation: 我下载了一个新应用来追踪我的运动情况。

scenes.sentence: This app makes it easy to pay bills online.
scenes.translation: 这个应用让在线支付账单变得很容易。

scenes.sentence: The sheer scale of the canyon appalled the tourists who had never seen such a vast landscape.
scenes.translation: 峡谷的宏大尺度让从未见过如此广阔景色的游客感到震惊。

scenes.sentence: The corruption scandal appalled the public, leading to widespread protests.
scenes.translation: 腐败丑闻令公众震惊，引发了广泛的抗议。

nodes.name: application
nodes.meaning: n. 申请；应用程序；应用

scenes.sentence: She submitted her application for the manager position yesterday.
scenes.translation: 她昨天提交了经理职位的申请书。

scenes.sentence: This application is free to download and use on your smartphone.
scenes.translation: 这个应用程序可以在你的智能手机上免费下载和使用。

scenes.sentence: The practical application of this theory requires more experiments.
scenes.translation: 该理论的实际应用需要更多的实验。

nodes.name: appoint
nodes.meaning: v. 任命，委派；指定，约定

scenes.sentence: The board of directors will appoint a new CEO next month.
scenes.translation: 董事会将于下月任命一位新首席执行官。

scenes.sentence: We have appointed a time for our meeting to discuss the project details.
scenes.translation: 我们已经约定了讨论项目细节的会议时间。

scenes.sentence: She completed a three-year apprenticeship in electrical engineering before securing a permanent job.
scenes.translation: 在完成为期三年的电气工程学徒期后，她获得了一份固定工作。

scenes.sentence: The apprenticeship program provides hands-on experience under the guidance of senior professionals.
scenes.translation: 该学徒计划由资深专业人士指导，提供实践经验。

nodes.name: approach
nodes.meaning: v. 接近；着手处理 n. 方法；途径

scenes.scene: 描述距离或时间的临近
scenes.sentence: Winter is approaching, so we need to prepare for the cold weather.
scenes.translation: 冬天快要到了，所以我们需要为寒冷天气做准备。

scenes.sentence: We need to adopt a new approach to solve this complex problem.
scenes.translation: 我们需要采用一种新方法来解决这个复杂的问题。

scenes.sentence: Many Arab people live in the Middle East.
scenes.translation: 许多阿拉伯人居住在中东地区。

scenes.sentence: She has been practicing archery since she was ten years old.
scenes.translation: 她自十岁起就开始练习射箭了。

scenes.sentence: Archery requires great concentration and steady hands.
scenes.translation: 射箭需要高度的专注和稳定的双手。

scenes.sentence: The architect designed a sustainable building that integrates solar energy.
scenes.translation: 这位建筑师设计了一座融合太阳能的可持续建筑。

scenes.sentence: She is the chief architect of the new urban planning project.
scenes.translation: 她是新城市规划项目的首席设计师。

nodes.name: architecture
nodes.meaning: n. 建筑学；建筑式样；架构

scenes.sentence: The study of ancient architecture reveals much about the cultural values of early civilizations.
scenes.translation: 对古代建筑的研究揭示了早期文明的许多文化价值观。

scenes.sentence: She loves the architecture of this city because of its tall skyscrapers.
scenes.translation: 她喜欢这座城市的建筑，因为那里有高耸的摩天大楼。

scenes.sentence: They often argue about which movie to watch.
scenes.translation: 他们经常争论看哪部电影。

scenes.sentence: The professor argued that the data was inconclusive.
scenes.translation: 教授主张数据尚不足以得出结论。

nodes.name: argumentative
nodes.meaning: adj. 好争论的，爱辩驳的

scenes.sentence: The argumentative student often challenged the professor's theories during seminars.
scenes.translation: 这位好争论的学生经常在研讨会上挑战教授的理论。

scenes.sentence: It is exhausting to have an argumentative conversation with someone who always insists on being right.
scenes.translation: 和一个总是坚持自己正确的人进行争辩性的对话是很令人疲惫的。

scenes.sentence: The arithmetic test was quite difficult for most students.
scenes.translation: 大多数学生觉得这次算术测试相当难。

scenes.sentence: Basic arithmetic skills are essential for everyday life.
scenes.translation: 基本的算术技能对日常生活至关重要。

scenes.sentence: The arithmetical errors in the report were due to a lack of rigorous verification by the accounting team.
scenes.translation: 报告中的算术错误是由于会计团队缺乏严格的验证。

scenes.sentence: While the logic was sound, the arithmetical calculations required a second check to ensure accuracy.
scenes.translation: 虽然逻辑是合理的，但算术计算需要第二次检查以确保准确性。

scenes.sentence: The garden was filled with the aromatic scent of blooming jasmine at dusk.
scenes.translation: 黄昏时分，花园里弥漫着盛开的茉莉花的芳香。

scenes.sentence: Chefs often use aromatic herbs like rosemary and thyme to enhance the flavor of the dish.
scenes.translation: 厨师经常使用迷迭香和百里香等芳香草本植物来增强菜肴的风味。

scenes.sentence: We need to make some arrangements for the meeting.
scenes.translation: 我们需要为会议做一些安排。

scenes.sentence: The hotel confirmed the booking arrangement last night.
scenes.translation: 酒店昨晚确认了预订安排。

nodes.name: arrest
nodes.meaning: v. 逮捕；吸引（注意） n. 逮捕

scenes.sentence: The police arrested the suspect for stealing.
scenes.translation: 警察逮捕了因盗窃被捕的嫌疑人。

scenes.sentence: Her beauty arrested everyone's attention.
scenes.translation: 她的美貌吸引了所有人的注意。

scenes.sentence: His arrogant attitude towards his colleagues made him unpopular in the office.
scenes.translation: 他对同事傲慢的态度使他在办公室里不受欢迎。

scenes.sentence: Don't be so arrogant; you still have a lot to learn.
scenes.translation: 别这么傲慢，你还有很多要学的。

nodes.name: article
nodes.meaning: n. 文章；物品；条款；冠词

scenes.sentence: I read an interesting article about climate change in the newspaper yesterday.
scenes.translation: 昨天我在报纸上读了一篇关于气候变化的有趣文章。

scenes.sentence: The lawyer explained each article of the contract carefully to ensure we understood our rights.
scenes.translation: 律师仔细解释了合同的每一条，以确保我们理解自己的权利。

scenes.sentence: She bought a new article of clothing for the party.
scenes.translation: 她为聚会买了一件新衣服。

nodes.name: artificial
nodes.meaning: adj. 人造的；仿造的；虚假的

scenes.sentence: The company is developing artificial intelligence to improve customer service.
scenes.translation: 该公司正在开发人工智能以提高客户服务。

scenes.sentence: Many flowers in the garden are artificial and do not require water.
scenes.translation: 花园里的许多花都是人造的，不需要浇水。

nodes.name: artistic
nodes.meaning: adj. 艺术的；有艺术天赋的

scenes.sentence: She has always shown artistic talent in drawing and painting.
scenes.translation: 她一直展现出绘画方面的艺术天赋。

scenes.sentence: The building has an artistic design that attracts many visitors.
scenes.translation: 这座建筑具有吸引许多游客的艺术设计。

scenes.sentence: She decided to major in arts to pursue her passion for painting.
scenes.translation: 她决定主修艺术，以追求她对绘画的热情。

scenes.sentence: The museum is a hub for local arts and culture.
scenes.translation: 该博物馆是当地艺术和文化的中心。

scenes.sentence: She is as tall as her brother.
scenes.translation: 她和她哥哥一样高。

scenes.sentence: As I was leaving, the phone rang.
scenes.translation: 当我正要离开时，电话响了。

scenes.sentence: He works as a teacher.
scenes.translation: 他作为一名老师工作。

scenes.sentence: Please reply to this email ASAP.
scenes.translation: 请尽快回复这封邮件。

scenes.sentence: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
scenes.translation: 亚洲是世界上最大的大陆。

scenes.sentence: We plan to visit several countries in Asia next summer.
scenes.translation: 我们计划明年夏天去亚洲的几个国家旅行。

scenes.sentence: We need to consider every aspect of the problem before making a decision.
scenes.translation: 在做出决定之前，我们需要考虑这个问题的每一个方面。

scenes.scene: 讨论事物的外观或外观特征
scenes.sentence: The building has a modern aspect that attracts many tourists.
scenes.translation: 这栋建筑具有吸引许多游客的现代外观。

nodes.name: assertive
nodes.meaning: adj. 自信的，果断的，敢于表达的

scenes.sentence: She is assertive in meetings, clearly stating her ideas without being aggressive.
scenes.translation: 她在会议上很自信，清晰地表达她的观点而不显得咄咄逼人。

scenes.sentence: Learning to be assertive helps you set healthy boundaries in relationships.
scenes.translation: 学会自信有助于你在人际关系中建立健康的界限。

nodes.name: associated
nodes.meaning: adj. 相关的；有联系的；联合的

scenes.sentence: The study identified several health issues associated with poor sleep quality.
scenes.translation: 这项研究确定了几个与睡眠质量差相关的健康问题。

scenes.sentence: We need to analyze the data associated with the previous quarter's performance.
scenes.translation: 我们需要分析与上一季度表现相关的数据。

nodes.name: athletics
nodes.meaning: n. 田径运动；体育竞技

scenes.sentence: The school athletics team won the championship this year.
scenes.translation: 学校田径队今年赢得了冠军。

scenes.sentence: He has a strong interest in athletics and runs every morning.
scenes.translation: 他对体育竞技有浓厚的兴趣，每天早晨都跑步。

scenes.sentence: I need to withdraw some cash from the ATM near the bank.
scenes.translation: 我需要从银行附近的自动取款机取一些现金。

scenes.sentence: The ATM card is not working because the machine is out of order.
scenes.translation: 自动取款卡无法使用，因为机器坏了。

scenes.sentence: The Earth's atmosphere protects us from harmful solar radiation.
scenes.translation: 地球的大气层保护我们要免受有害的太阳辐射。

scenes.sentence: The restaurant has a very relaxed and friendly atmosphere.
scenes.translation: 这家餐厅有着非常轻松友好的氛围。

scenes.sentence: The tense atmosphere in the interview room made the candidate nervous.
scenes.translation: 面试室里紧张的氛围让候选人感到紧张。

scenes.sentence: Please attach the file to the email.
scenes.translation: 请将该文件附加到电子邮件中。

scenes.sentence: He is emotionally attached to his old dog.
scenes.translation: 他在情感上依恋他的老狗。

scenes.sentence: The responsibility was attached to the new manager.
scenes.translation: 这项责任被指派给了新经理。

scenes.sentence: Please check the attachment for the detailed project schedule.
scenes.translation: 请查看附件以获取详细的项目进度表。

scenes.sentence: The baby showed a strong attachment to his mother.
scenes.translation: 婴儿对母亲表现出强烈的依恋。

scenes.sentence: She worked hard to attain her goal of graduating with honors.
scenes.translation: 她努力工作以实现以荣誉学位毕业的目标。

scenes.sentence: It took him ten years to attain the position of manager.
scenes.translation: 他花了十年时间才达到经理的职位。

nodes.name: attainable
nodes.meaning: adj. 可获得的；可达到的

scenes.sentence: Would you like a cup of tea with your biscuit?
scenes.translation: 你想在吃饼干时配一杯茶吗？

scenes.sentence: Don't forget to buy some milk and biscuits for the party.
scenes.translation: 别忘了为聚会买一些牛奶和饼干。

nodes.name: bit
nodes.meaning: n. 少量；碎片；（马的）嚼子 v. 咬；啃

scenes.sentence: I only ate a small bit of the cake.
scenes.translation: 我只吃了一点蛋糕。

scenes.sentence: The dog bit the mailman.
scenes.translation: 那只狗咬了邮递员。

scenes.sentence: Take a break and have a bit of rest.
scenes.translation: 休息一下，歇一会儿。

nodes.name: bite
nodes.meaning: v. 咬；叮 n. 一口；咬

scenes.sentence: The boy took a big bite of the apple.
scenes.translation: 男孩咬了一大口苹果。

scenes.sentence: Be careful, the dog might bite.
scenes.translation: 小心，这只狗可能会咬人。

nodes.name: bitter
nodes.meaning: adj. 苦的；痛苦的；激烈的；寒冷的

scenes.sentence: The medicine tastes bitter.
scenes.translation: 这药尝起来很苦。

scenes.sentence: It was a bitter defeat for the team.
scenes.translation: 对这支队伍来说，这是一个痛苦的失败。

scenes.sentence: We faced a bitter cold wind.
scenes.translation: 我们面临着刺骨的寒风。

nodes.name: bitterly
nodes.meaning: adv. 痛苦地；激烈地；严寒地

scenes.sentence: The wind blew bitterly cold through the open window.
scenes.translation: 寒风凛冽，从敞开的窗户吹进来。

scenes.sentence: She wept bitterly when she heard the bad news.
scenes.translation: 听到这个坏消息时，她悲痛欲绝。

scenes.sentence: The two candidates attacked each other bitterly in the debate.
scenes.translation: 两位候选人在辩论中激烈地互相攻击。

scenes.sentence: The local customs appeared bizarre to the foreign visitors.
scenes.translation: 当地的风俗对来访的外国人来说显得非常奇怪。

scenes.sentence: The artist's bizarre sculptures challenged conventional notions of beauty.
scenes.translation: 这位艺术家的奇异雕塑挑战了传统的美感观念。

nodes.name: black
nodes.meaning: adj. 黑色的; n. 黑色

scenes.sentence: She wore a black dress to the party.
scenes.translation: 她穿了一条黑色连衣裙去参加聚会。

scenes.sentence: The sky turned black before the storm.
scenes.translation: 暴风雨来临前，天空变黑了。

nodes.name: blame
nodes.meaning: v. 责备；谴责 n. 责备；责任

scenes.sentence: Don't blame me for the mistake; it was your responsibility to check the data.
scenes.translation: 别因为这个错误责怪我；检查数据是你的责任。

scenes.sentence: The report attributes the decline in sales primarily to the company's failure to adapt to changing market trends, rather than blaming external economic factors.
scenes.translation: 报告将销售额的下降主要归因于公司未能适应不断变化的市场趋势，而不是归咎于外部经济因素。

scenes.sentence: The soup was bland and needed more salt.
scenes.translation: 这汤味道淡，需要加点盐。

scenes.sentence: He has a bland personality that lacks excitement.
scenes.translation: 他性格平淡，缺乏激情。

nodes.name: blast
nodes.meaning: v. 爆炸; 吹; 猛攻 n. 爆炸; 一阵风

scenes.sentence: The gas pipe blast caused significant damage to the building.
scenes.translation: 煤气管道爆炸对该建筑造成了严重损坏。

scenes.sentence: A blast of hot air hit us as we opened the oven.
scenes.translation: 当我们打开烤箱时，一股热浪扑面而来。

nodes.name: blaze
nodes.meaning: n. 烈火；v. 燃烧；照耀

scenes.sentence: The house was in full blaze when the firefighters arrived.
scenes.translation: 消防员到达时，房子已经大火熊熊。

scenes.sentence: The campfire blazed brightly against the dark night sky.
scenes.translation: 营火在漆黑的夜空中明亮地燃烧着。

nodes.name: blink
nodes.meaning: v. 眨眼；闪烁 n. 眨眼

scenes.sentence: Don't blink or you'll miss it.
scenes.translation: 别眨眼，否则你会错过的。

scenes.sentence: The lights in the city blink at night.
scenes.translation: 城市的灯光在夜晚闪烁。

nodes.name: block
nodes.meaning: n. 块；街区；障碍 v. 阻挡；阻塞

scenes.sentence: The traffic was blocked by a large truck on the main road.
scenes.translation: 主干道上的交通被一辆大卡车堵住了。

scenes.sentence: Don't let small problems block your way to success.
scenes.translation: 不要让小问题阻挡你通往成功的道路。

scenes.sentence: We live in a quiet block of flats near the park.
scenes.translation: 我们住在公园附近的一栋安静的公寓楼里。

nodes.name: blog
nodes.meaning: n. 博客 v. 写博客

scenes.sentence: I read your blog every morning.
scenes.translation: 我每天早上都读你的博客。

scenes.sentence: She started a blog about cooking.
scenes.translation: 她开了一个关于烹饪的博客。

nodes.name: blonde
nodes.meaning: adj. 金色的 n. 金发女郎

scenes.sentence: She has long blonde hair and blue eyes.
scenes.translation: 她有着长长的金发和蓝色的眼睛。

scenes.sentence: The blonde woman walked gracefully across the sunlit meadow.
scenes.translation: 那位金发女子优雅地走过阳光普照的草地。

nodes.name: blossom
nodes.meaning: n. 花；开花 v. 开花；发展

scenes.sentence: The cherry trees began to blossom in early spring, filling the park with pink petals.
scenes.translation: 樱花树在早春开始开花，使公园里充满了粉色的花瓣。

scenes.scene: 描述个人成长或事业起步
scenes.sentence: Her talent for painting started to blossom after she joined the local art club.
scenes.translation: 加入当地艺术俱乐部后，她的绘画天赋开始显现。

nodes.name: blue-eyed
nodes.meaning: adj. 蓝眼睛的；受宠爱的

scenes.sentence: She has a pair of bright blue-eyed eyes that catch everyone's attention.
scenes.translation: 她有一双明亮的蓝眼睛，吸引了每个人的注意。

scenes.sentence: In this family, the blue-eyed child is always the one who gets the most gifts.
scenes.translation: 在这个家里，受宠爱的孩子总是得到最多礼物的人。

nodes.name: blunt
nodes.meaning: adj. 迟钝的；不锋利的；直率的 v. 使变钝

scenes.sentence: The knife is too blunt to cut the bread.
scenes.translation: 这把刀太钝了，切不动面包。

scenes.sentence: She was blunt about her opinion on the project.
scenes.translation: 她对项目的看法直言不讳。

nodes.name: blush
nodes.meaning: v./n. 脸红；因害羞、尴尬或羞愧而脸红

scenes.sentence: She began to blush when he complimented her.
scenes.translation: 当他称赞她时，她开始脸红了。

scenes.sentence: A deep blush spread across her cheeks.
scenes.translation: 深深的红晕蔓延到她的脸颊上。

nodes.name: boast
nodes.meaning: v. 吹嘘，自夸；拥有（值得自豪的事物）

scenes.sentence: The company boasts a loyal customer base of over one million.
scenes.translation: 该公司拥有超过一百万的忠实客户群。

scenes.sentence: He always boasts about his achievements.
scenes.translation: 他总是吹嘘他的成就。

nodes.name: book
nodes.meaning: n. 书；账簿 v. 预订；登记

scenes.sentence: I borrowed a book about animals from the library.
scenes.translation: 我从图书馆借了一本关于动物的书。

scenes.sentence: We need to book a table for two people tonight.
scenes.translation: 我们需要预订今晚两人的餐桌。

scenes.sentence: I made a booking for a double room at the hotel.
scenes.translation: 我在酒店预订了一间双人房。

scenes.sentence: The booking fee is non-refundable once confirmed.
scenes.translation: 一旦确认，预订费不予退还。

scenes.sentence: I used a bookmark to keep my place in the novel.
scenes.translation: 我用书签标记我在小说中的阅读进度。

scenes.sentence: Please bookmark this website for future reference.
scenes.translation: 请把这个网站加入书签以便将来参考。

nodes.name: boost
nodes.meaning: v. 增加，提高；促进，推动

scenes.sentence: The government introduced new policies to boost economic growth.
scenes.translation: 政府推出了新政策以促进经济增长。

scenes.sentence: The good news gave a boost to everyone's confidence.
scenes.translation: 这个好消息给了大家信心上的鼓舞。

scenes.sentence: The lecturer struggled to maintain the audience's attention, as a profound sense of boredom began to permeate the hall.
scenes.translation: 讲师难以维持听众的注意力，因为一种深刻的厌倦感开始弥漫在整个大厅里。

scenes.sentence: She found herself trapped in a monotonous routine, succumbing to the creeping boredom that threatened to stifle her creative spirit.
scenes.translation: 她发现自己被困在单调的例行公事中，屈服于那威胁要扼杀她创造力的逐渐蔓延的无聊感。

scenes.sentence: The boss is very strict about the project deadline.
scenes.translation: 老板对项目截止日期非常严格。

scenes.sentence: I need to talk to my boss about my salary.
scenes.translation: 我需要和我的老板谈谈我的薪水。

nodes.name: bossy
nodes.meaning: adj. 专横的，好发号施令的

scenes.sentence: My bossy sister always tells me what to do.
scenes.translation: 我那个爱发号施令的姐姐总是告诉我该做什么。

scenes.sentence: The bossy manager made everyone feel uncomfortable.
scenes.translation: 那位专横的经理让每个人都感到不舒服。

nodes.name: bother
nodes.meaning: v. 打扰，烦扰；n. 麻烦，困难

scenes.sentence: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me with this report?
scenes.translation: 抱歉打扰你，你能帮帮我处理这份报告吗？

scenes.sentence: The constant noise from the construction site is really bothering the employees.
scenes.translation: 建筑工地的持续噪音真的让员工们很心烦。

scenes.sentence: He didn't bother to explain the details, which caused a lot of confusion.
scenes.translation: 他没有费心去解释细节，这导致了大量的困惑。

scenes.sentence: She bought a bottle of water.
scenes.translation: 她买了一瓶水。

scenes.sentence: Please put the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
scenes.translation: 请把空瓶子放进回收箱。

scenes.sentence: The heavy snow broke the bough of the old oak tree.
scenes.translation: 大雪压断了老橡树的一根树枝。

scenes.sentence: Birds were singing sweetly in the shady boughs.
scenes.translation: 鸟儿在阴凉的树枝间甜蜜地歌唱。

nodes.name: bow
nodes.meaning: v. 弯腰; 鞠躬; 弯曲 n. 弓; 蝴蝶结; 鞠躬

scenes.sentence: The queen bowed to the crowd as she entered the palace.
scenes.translation: 女王进入宫殿时向人群鞠躬致意。

scenes.sentence: He took a bow after finishing his performance on stage.
scenes.translation: 他在舞台上完成表演后鞠了一躬。

nodes.name: bowl
nodes.meaning: n. 碗；钵； bowl shape 球体

scenes.sentence: Please put the rice in a bowl.
scenes.translation: 请把米饭放进碗里。

scenes.sentence: He kicked the ball into the bowl-shaped stadium.
scenes.translation: 他把球踢进了碗状的体育场。

nodes.name: bowls
nodes.meaning: n. 碗；碗状物；保龄球；大锅

scenes.sentence: Please put the dirty bowls in the sink.
scenes.translation: 请把脏碗放进水槽里。

scenes.sentence: She washed the bowls and plates carefully.
scenes.translation: 她仔细地清洗了碗和盘子。

nodes.name: box
nodes.meaning: n. 盒子；箱 v. 拳击；装盒

scenes.sentence: Please put the books in the box.
scenes.translation: 请把书放进盒子里。

scenes.sentence: He likes to box in his free time.
scenes.translation: 他喜欢在空闲时间拳击。

scenes.sentence: She bought a new bra at the department store.
scenes.translation: 她在百货商店买了一件新胸罩。

nodes.name: braces
nodes.meaning: n. 支架；支撑物；（复数）背带；v. 支撑；使坚强（brace的第三人称单数）

scenes.sentence: The dentist recommended braces to correct her misaligned teeth.
scenes.translation: 牙医建议她戴牙套来矫正排列不齐的牙齿。

scenes.sentence: Engineers installed steel braces to reinforce the bridge during the storm.
scenes.translation: 工程师在暴风雨期间安装了钢支架以加固桥梁。

scenes.sentence: She braced herself for the bad news before opening the letter.
scenes.translation: 在打开信之前，她做好了听到坏消息的心理准备。

nodes.name: brake
nodes.meaning: n. 刹车 v. 刹车

scenes.sentence: The driver pressed the brake to stop the car.
scenes.translation: 司机踩下刹车使车停下。

scenes.sentence: Be careful, your brake lights are not working.
scenes.translation: 小心，你的刹车灯不亮了。

nodes.name: branch
nodes.meaning: n. 树枝；分支；部门 v. 分支；分叉

scenes.sentence: A bird built a nest in the branch of the tree.
scenes.translation: 一只鸟在树枝上筑了巢。

scenes.sentence: The company has a branch office in Shanghai.
scenes.translation: 这家公司在上海有一个分公司。

scenes.sentence: Take the right branch of the road.
scenes.translation: 走右边的岔路。

scenes.sentence: She bought a brand-new car yesterday.
scenes.translation: 她昨天买了一辆崭新的汽车。

scenes.sentence: He is a brand-new student in our class.
scenes.translation: 他是我们班的一名新学生。

scenes.sentence: The breadth of the professor's knowledge was evident in his ability to discuss complex topics with ease.
scenes.translation: 教授在轻松讨论复杂话题时展现出的知识广度令人印象深刻

scenes.sentence: We admired the breadth of the river as we stood on the bank.
scenes.translation: 站在河岸上时，我们惊叹于河面的宽阔

nodes.name: break
nodes.meaning: v. 打破；折断；中断 n. 休息；中断

scenes.sentence: Don't break the glass.
scenes.translation: 别打碎玻璃。

scenes.sentence: We have a ten-minute break between classes.
scenes.translation: 课间我们有十分钟的休息时间。

nodes.name: breakdown
nodes.meaning: n. 故障；崩溃；分解；剖析

scenes.sentence: The project suffered a complete breakdown in communication between the two departments.
scenes.translation: 该项目在两个部门之间出现了彻底的沟通中断。

scenes.sentence: A mechanical breakdown on the highway caused a three-mile traffic jam.
scenes.translation: 高速公路上的一次机械故障导致了三英里的交通拥堵。

scenes.sentence: He suffered a nervous breakdown after months of intense pressure.
scenes.translation: 在经历了数月的巨大压力后，他精神崩溃了。

nodes.name: breakout
nodes.meaning: n. 突发；越狱；突破性事件；(疾病、火灾等的)突然爆发

scenes.sentence: The government declared a public health emergency to contain the sudden outbreak of the virus.
scenes.translation: 政府宣布进入公共卫生紧急状态，以遏制病毒的突然爆发。

scenes.sentence: The indie film became an unexpected breakout hit at the box office.
scenes.translation: 这部独立电影在票房上成为了意想不到的突破性成功之作。

scenes.sentence: The new battery technology represents a significant breakthrough in renewable energy storage.
scenes.translation: 这种新电池技术代表了可再生能源存储领域的重大突破。

scenes.sentence: Scientists have made a breakthrough in the treatment of this rare disease.
scenes.translation: 科学家们在治疗这种罕见疾病方面取得了突破。

scenes.sentence: Take a deep breath and relax.
scenes.translation: 深吸一口气，放松下来。

scenes.sentence: He was out of breath after running.
scenes.translation: 跑步后他上气不接下气。

scenes.sentence: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly to calm down.
scenes.translation: 深吸一口气，慢慢呼吸以冷静下来。

scenes.sentence: You need to breathe properly while running.
scenes.translation: 跑步时你需要正确呼吸。

nodes.name: breathless
nodes.meaning: adj. 气喘吁吁的；屏息的；激动的

scenes.scene: 描述剧烈运动后的状态
scenes.sentence: She was breathless after running up the stairs.
scenes.translation: 她跑完楼梯后气喘吁吁。

scenes.scene: 形容因紧张或期待而屏息
scenes.sentence: The audience was breathless with anticipation.
scenes.translation: 观众屏息以待。

scenes.sentence: The view from the mountain top was truly breathtaking.
scenes.translation: 山顶的景色真是令人叹为观止。

scenes.sentence: She made a breathtaking recovery after the surgery.
scenes.translation: 手术后她恢复得惊人地快。

nodes.name: breed
nodes.meaning: v. 繁殖；养育；生（仔） n. 种类；品种

scenes.sentence: Many animals breed during the spring when food is abundant.
scenes.translation: 许多动物在食物充足的春季繁殖。

scenes.sentence: We decided not to breed our cat because we couldn't find homes for all the kittens.
scenes.translation: 我们决定不繁殖我们的猫，因为我们无法为所有小猫找到家。

scenes.sentence: Farmers carefully breed cattle to improve milk production.
scenes.translation: 农民们精心培育牛只以提高产奶量。

scenes.sentence: A cool breeze blew through the open window.
scenes.translation: 一阵凉风从打开的窗户吹了进来。

scenes.sentence: Finishing the project was a breeze for her.
scenes.translation: 对她来说，完成这个项目轻而易举。

scenes.sentence: The house is built of red brick.
scenes.translation: 这栋房子是用红砖建的。

scenes.sentence: He carried a heavy brick to the construction site.
scenes.translation: 他搬着一块沉重的砖头去了建筑工地。

scenes.sentence: Please briefly summarize the main points of the project.
scenes.translation: 请简要总结项目的主要要点。

scenes.sentence: He briefly explained the rules before starting the game.
scenes.translation: 在游戏开始前，他简要解释了规则。

nodes.name: bright
nodes.meaning: adj. 明亮的；聪明的；鲜艳的

scenes.sentence: It was a bright and sunny day.
scenes.translation: 那是一个明亮晴朗的日子。

scenes.sentence: She is a bright student with a promising future.
scenes.translation: 她是一个聪明的学生，前途光明。

scenes.sentence: The brightness of the screen can be adjusted to suit your eyes.
scenes.translation: 屏幕的亮度可以根据你的眼睛进行调整。

scenes.sentence: She added a touch of brightness to the dull room with colorful curtains.
scenes.translation: 她用彩色的窗帘为沉闷的房间增添了一抹亮色。

nodes.name: brilliantly
nodes.meaning: adv. 明亮地；杰出地；辉煌地

scenes.sentence: The candidate answered the complex questions brilliantly during the interview.
scenes.translation: 候选人在面试中出色地回答了那些复杂的问题。

scenes.sentence: She was brilliantly dressed, wearing a gown that caught the light perfectly.
scenes.translation: 她穿着华丽，身穿一件完美捕捉光线的礼服。

nodes.name: Briton
nodes.meaning: n. 不列颠人; 英国人

scenes.sentence: The Briton population is diverse, including people from various ethnic backgrounds.
scenes.translation: 英国人口是多元化的，包括来自各种族背景的人。

scenes.sentence: As a Briton, he takes pride in the country's long history and royal traditions.
scenes.translation: 作为一个英国人，他为这个国家悠久的历史和皇室传统感到自豪。

nodes.name: broad
nodes.meaning: adj. 宽阔的；广泛的；概括的

scenes.sentence: The river is very broad at this point.
scenes.translation: 这条河在这一段非常宽阔。

scenes.sentence: She has a broad knowledge of history.
scenes.translation: 她对历史有着广泛的了解。

scenes.sentence: There is a broad consensus among the experts.
scenes.translation: 专家们达成了广泛的共识。

scenes.sentence: The university has upgraded to broadband to support online learning.
scenes.translation: 大学已升级为宽带以支持在线学习。

scenes.sentence: We need broadband to stream movies without buffering.
scenes.translation: 我们需要宽带来流畅播放电影而不缓冲。

nodes.name: broadcast
nodes.meaning: v. 广播；播放 n. 广播；节目

scenes.sentence: The news will be broadcast live on television tonight.
scenes.translation: 新闻今晚将在电视上现场直播。

scenes.sentence: Farmers often broadcast seeds over the field by hand.
scenes.translation: 农民经常用手将种子撒在田地里。

scenes.sentence: Studying abroad can broaden your horizons and help you understand different cultures.
scenes.translation: 出国留学可以开阔你的视野，帮助你了解不同的文化。

scenes.sentence: She took on new responsibilities to broaden her professional skills.
scenes.translation: 她承担新的职责以拓宽她的专业技能。

nodes.name: broadminded
nodes.meaning: adj. 心胸宽广的，开明的

scenes.sentence: A broadminded manager is more likely to accept diverse opinions from the team.
scenes.translation: 心胸宽广的经理更有可能接受团队的不同意见。

scenes.sentence: We need to cultivate a broadminded attitude towards cultural differences.
scenes.translation: 我们需要培养对文化差异的包容态度。

scenes.sentence: The broad-shouldered man carried the heavy box with ease.

scenes.translation: 尽管遇到困难，团队仍然对项目保持忠诚。

scenes.sentence: She is committed to helping people in need.
scenes.translation: 她致力于帮助有需要的人。

scenes.sentence: The companionship of his wife was the greatest comfort he had after retirement.
scenes.translation: 妻子的陪伴是他退休后最大的慰藉。

scenes.sentence: He joined the club seeking companionship rather than just for the games.
scenes.translation: 他加入这个俱乐部是为了寻求陪伴，而不仅仅是为了玩游戏。

nodes.name: company
nodes.meaning: n. 公司；陪伴；连队；宾客

scenes.sentence: The company announced its quarterly profits yesterday.
scenes.translation: 该公司昨天宣布了季度利润。

scenes.sentence: I enjoy your company when we study together.
scenes.translation: 我们一起学习时，我很享受你的陪伴。

scenes.sentence: She won the first prize in the singing competition.
scenes.translation: 她在歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

scenes.sentence: The company is facing fierce competition from its rivals.
scenes.translation: 该公司正面临着来自对手的激烈竞争。

scenes.sentence: The company is facing increasing competitive pressure from new market entrants.
scenes.translation: 该公司正面临来自新市场进入者的日益激烈的竞争压力。

scenes.sentence: She has a highly competitive nature, always striving to be the best in her class.
scenes.translation: 她生性好胜，总是力争成为班里最好的。

scenes.sentence: Customers can complain to the manager if the service is poor.
scenes.translation: 如果服务不好，顾客可以向经理投诉。

scenes.sentence: He always complains about the weather.
scenes.translation: 他总是抱怨天气。

scenes.sentence: Her complexion was pale after the long illness.
scenes.translation: 长时间生病后，她的脸色苍白。

scenes.sentence: This cream is designed to improve your complexion.
scenes.translation: 这款面霜旨在改善你的肤色。

nodes.name: complication
nodes.meaning: n. 复杂因素；并发症；麻烦

scenes.sentence: The patient's recovery was delayed by a serious complication.
scenes.translation: 病人的恢复因严重的并发症而延误。

scenes.sentence: We underestimated the complications involved in the project.
scenes.translation: 我们低估了项目中涉及的复杂因素。

nodes.name: compose
nodes.meaning: v. 组成；创作；写；使平静

scenes.sentence: The city is composed of several distinct districts.
scenes.translation: 这座城市由几个不同的区域组成。

scenes.sentence: He began to compose a new symphony for the orchestra.
scenes.translation: 他开始为管弦乐队创作一首新的交响乐。

scenes.sentence: The composer's latest symphony was performed by the national orchestra to great acclaim.
scenes.translation: 这位作曲家的最新交响乐由国立乐团演奏，广受好评。

nodes.name: composition
nodes.meaning: n. 作文；作曲；成分；构图

scenes.sentence: The professor graded the composition based on its structure and argumentation.
scenes.translation: 教授根据结构和论证给这篇作文打分。

scenes.sentence: The composition of the painting uses a triangular arrangement to guide the viewer's eye.
scenes.translation: 这幅画的构图采用三角形排列来引导观众的视线。

scenes.sentence: The chemical composition of water is H2O.
scenes.translation: 水的化学成分是H2O。

nodes.name: compromise
nodes.meaning: v. 妥协；让步；损害 n. 妥协；折中方案

scenes.sentence: Both parties were forced to compromise on the price to reach a deal.
scenes.translation: 双方被迫在价格上妥协以达成协议。

scenes.sentence: The researcher had to compromise on her methodology due to limited funding.
scenes.translation: 由于资金有限，研究人员不得不在研究方法上做出妥协。

scenes.sentence: Attendance at the orientation session is compulsory for all new students.
scenes.translation: 所有新生都必须参加迎新会议。

scenes.sentence: Wearing seatbelts is compulsory by law in most countries.
scenes.translation: 在大多数国家，系安全带是法律强制要求的。

nodes.name: conclude
nodes.meaning: v. 结束；推断；达成协议

scenes.sentence: The professor concluded his lecture by summarizing the key arguments.
scenes.translation: 教授通过总结主要论点结束了他的讲座。

scenes.sentence: Both parties concluded a deal after weeks of negotiation.
scenes.translation: 经过数周的谈判，双方达成了一项协议。

scenes.sentence: From the evidence, we can conclude that he was innocent.
scenes.translation: 根据证据，我们可以推断他是无辜的。

scenes.sentence: His health condition has improved significantly.
scenes.translation: 他的健康状况已显著改善。

scenes.sentence: The company offered favorable working conditions.
scenes.translation: 公司提供了优厚的工作条件。

scenes.sentence: Weather conditions are perfect for a picnic.
scenes.translation: 天气条件非常适合野餐。

nodes.name: conduct
nodes.meaning: v. 引导；实施；传导 n. 行为；举止

scenes.sentence: The teacher will conduct a science experiment in class.
scenes.translation: 老师将在课堂上进行一项科学实验。

scenes.sentence: His conduct in the competition was very professional.
scenes.translation: 他在比赛中的表现非常专业。

scenes.sentence: He finally confessed to the theft after the police found the evidence.
scenes.translation: 警察找到证据后，他最终承认了盗窃行为。

scenes.sentence: She confessed her love to him under the starry sky.
scenes.translation: 她在星空下向他坦白了爱意。

scenes.sentence: She felt confident about her performance in the final exam.
scenes.translation: 她对期末考的表现感到自信。

scenes.sentence: He was confident that he would get the job offer.
scenes.translation: 他确信自己会得到那份工作录用通知。

nodes.name: conflict
nodes.meaning: n. 冲突；争论 v. 冲突；抵触

scenes.sentence: The conflict between the two brothers lasted for years.
scenes.translation: 两兄弟之间的冲突持续了多年。

scenes.sentence: There is a conflict between his beliefs and his actions.
scenes.translation: 他的信仰和行为之间存在冲突。

scenes.sentence: Armed conflicts in the region have caused many refugees.
scenes.translation: 该地区的武装冲突造成了许多难民。

scenes.sentence: I was confused by the complicated instructions.
scenes.translation: 我被复杂的说明搞糊涂了。

scenes.sentence: Many students felt confused about the new grammar rules.
scenes.translation: 许多学生对新的语法规则感到困惑。

scenes.sentence: The sudden announcement caused great confusion among the staff.
scenes.translation: 突然的公告在员工中引起了极大的困惑。

scenes.sentence: I was in a state of complete confusion about which path to take.
scenes.translation: 对于该走哪条路，我处于完全困惑的状态。

nodes.name: Congress
nodes.meaning: n. 国会；议会；代表大会

scenes.sentence: The Congress passed a new law to improve the healthcare system.
scenes.translation: 国会通过了一项新法律以改善医疗体系。

scenes.sentence: Thousands of scientists attended the annual Congress in Paris.
scenes.translation: 数千名科学家参加了在巴黎举行的年度大会。

scenes.sentence: The patient lost consciousness after the accident.
scenes.translation: 事故发生后，病人失去了意识。

scenes.sentence: There is growing public consciousness about environmental protection.
scenes.translation: 公众对环境保护的意识正在增强。

scenes.sentence: The consequences of climate change are becoming increasingly severe.
scenes.translation: 气候变化的后果正变得日益严重。

scenes.sentence: You must accept the consequences of your actions.
scenes.translation: 你必须接受你行为的后果。

scenes.sentence: The road was icy; consequently, the cars moved very slowly.
scenes.translation: 路面结冰了，因此车辆行驶得非常缓慢。

scenes.sentence: The conservation of natural resources is crucial for the survival of future generations.
scenes.translation: 自然资源的保护对于后代的生存至关重要。

scenes.sentence: Energy conservation measures can significantly reduce household electricity bills.
scenes.translation: 节能措施可以显著降低家庭电费。

nodes.name: conservative
nodes.meaning: adj. 保守的；守旧的；保守主义的

scenes.sentence: He holds conservative views on economic reform, preferring gradual change over radical policies.
scenes.translation: 他在经济改革问题上持有保守观点，倾向于渐进式变革而非激进政策。

scenes.sentence: The conservative approach to education emphasizes traditional values and discipline.
scenes.translation: 这种保守的教育方法强调传统价值观和纪律。

scenes.sentence: I consider this a great opportunity.
scenes.translation: 我认为这是一个极好的机会。

scenes.sentence: We need to consider all the costs before making a decision.
scenes.translation: 在做出决定之前，我们需要考虑所有成本。

scenes.sentence: The professor asked students to consider the ethical implications of the experiment.
scenes.translation: 教授要求学生考虑该实验的伦理影响。

nodes.name: considerable
nodes.meaning: adj. 相当大的；重要的；值得考虑的

scenes.sentence: The study revealed a considerable increase in student engagement after implementing the new curriculum.
scenes.translation: 研究表明，实施新课程后，学生参与度有了显著增加。

scenes.sentence: The company has made considerable progress in reducing carbon emissions this quarter.
scenes.translation: 该公司在本季度在减少碳排放方面取得了显著进展。

scenes.sentence: The company plans to consolidate its market position by acquiring smaller competitors.
scenes.translation: 公司计划通过收购较小的竞争对手来巩固其市场地位。

scenes.sentence: Researchers need to consolidate their findings before publishing the final report.
scenes.translation: 研究人员需要在发布最终报告之前整合他们的发现。

nodes.name: constituency
nodes.meaning: n. 选区；选举区；（议会或政党的）支持者群体

scenes.sentence: The MP promised to work hard to represent the interests of his entire constituency during the upcoming election.
scenes.translation: 这位议员承诺在即将到来的选举中努力代表他整个选区的利益。

scenes.sentence: The new policy failed to gain support from the academic constituency, who argued that it lacked scientific basis.
scenes.translation: 新政策未能获得学术界支持者群体的支持，他们认为该政策缺乏科学依据。

scenes.sentence: The average household consumes a significant amount of electricity every month.
scenes.translation: 普通家庭每月消耗大量电力。

scenes.sentence: Fossil fuels are consumed at an alarming rate, leading to environmental concerns.
scenes.translation: 化石燃料正以惊人的速度被消耗，引发了环境问题。

nodes.name: contact
nodes.meaning: n. 接触；联系 v. 联系；接触

scenes.sentence: I lost contact with my old friends after moving to a new city.
scenes.translation: 搬到新城市后，我和老朋友失去了联系。

scenes.sentence: Direct contact with the chemical can cause skin irritation.
scenes.translation: 直接接触这种化学物质可能会导致皮肤刺激。

nodes.name: contemporary
nodes.meaning: adj. 当代的；同时代的 n. 同时代人

scenes.sentence: Contemporary art often challenges traditional norms and provokes critical thinking among viewers.
scenes.translation: 当代艺术经常挑战传统规范并引发观众的批判性思维。

scenes.sentence: The novel explores the complex social dynamics between people of different contemporary backgrounds.
scenes.translation: 这部小说探讨了不同当代背景的人们之间复杂的社会动态。

nodes.name: content
nodes.meaning: adj. 满意的；n. 内容；容量

scenes.sentence: Are you content with the service provided?
scenes.translation: 你对提供的服务满意吗？

scenes.sentence: The table of contents lists all the chapters in the book.
scenes.translation: 目录列出了书中的所有章节。

nodes.name: contest
nodes.meaning: v. 竞争；对…表示怀疑 n. 比赛；竞赛

scenes.sentence: The professor challenged the validity of the data, causing students to contest the initial findings.
scenes.translation: 教授质疑数据的有效性，导致学生们对初步发现提出质疑。

scenes.sentence: Athletes from various countries will contest the gold medal in the upcoming Olympic Games.
scenes.translation: 来自各国的运动员将在即将举行的奥运会上争夺金牌。

nodes.name: contract
nodes.meaning: v. 缩小；订合同；感染；收缩

scenes.sentence: The two companies decided to contract for the construction of the new bridge.
scenes.translation: 两家公司决定签订建造新大桥的合同。

scenes.sentence: Muscles contract when they are used.
scenes.translation: 肌肉在使用时会收缩。

scenes.sentence: He contracted a serious illness during his trip abroad.
scenes.translation: 他在出国旅行期间染上了重病。

nodes.name: contribute
nodes.meaning: v. 贡献，捐献；投稿；导致

scenes.sentence: Everyone can contribute to protecting the environment by recycling.
scenes.translation: 每个人都可以通过回收利用为保护环境做出贡献。

scenes.sentence: She contributed a lot of ideas to the group project.
scenes.translation: 她为小组项目贡献了很多想法。

scenes.sentence: Bad weather contributed to the accident.
scenes.translation: 恶劣的天气导致了这起事故。

scenes.sentence: The research challenges the conventional wisdom that economic growth always leads to improved living standards.
scenes.translation: 这项研究挑战了经济增长总能提高生活水平的传统观念。

scenes.sentence: They decided to take a more conventional approach to solving the problem.
scenes.translation: 他们决定采取一种更传统的方法来解决这个问题。

scenes.sentence: The company is undergoing a major conversion to digital platforms.
scenes.translation: 公司正在向数字平台进行重大转型。

scenes.sentence: His conversion to Buddhism changed his lifestyle completely.
scenes.translation: 他皈依佛教彻底改变了他的生活方式。

scenes.sentence: He converted to Buddhism after years of searching for meaning.
scenes.translation: 在多年寻找人生意义后，他皈依了佛教。

scenes.sentence: You can convert your dollars into euros at the bank.
scenes.translation: 你可以在银行将美元兑换成欧元。

scenes.sentence: They converted the old factory into a modern art gallery.
scenes.translation: 他们将旧工厂改造成了一个现代艺术画廊。

nodes.name: convict
nodes.meaning: v. 证明…有罪；使确信 n. 罪犯

scenes.translation: 陪审团判定他有罪，法官判定他犯有欺诈罪。

scenes.sentence: I tried to convict her of the mistake, but she refused to admit it.
scenes.translation: 我试图让她承认那个错误，但她拒绝承认。

nodes.name: conviction
nodes.meaning: n. 定罪；确信；坚定的信念

scenes.sentence: The jury reached a unanimous conviction after reviewing the evidence.
scenes.translation: 陪审团在审查证据后达成了定罪的一致意见。

scenes.sentence: She spoke with great conviction about the importance of environmental protection.
scenes.translation: 她充满激情地阐述了环境保护的重要性。

scenes.sentence: The lawyer tried to convince the jury of his client's innocence.
scenes.translation: 律师试图让陪审团相信他的当事人是无辜的。

scenes.sentence: I couldn't convince her to come with us.
scenes.translation: 我无法说服她和我们一起来。

scenes.sentence: I baked some chocolate chip cookies for the party.
scenes.translation: 我为派对烤了一些巧克力曲奇饼。

nodes.name: cool
nodes.meaning: adj. 凉爽的；冷静的；酷的 n. 凉爽 v. 冷却

scenes.sentence: It's a cool evening in autumn.
scenes.translation: 这是一个凉爽的秋夜。

scenes.sentence: Stay cool and don't panic during the exam.
scenes.translation: 考试期间保持冷静，不要惊慌。

scenes.sentence: That's a cool idea!
scenes.translation: 这个主意太酷了！

nodes.name: co-opt
nodes.meaning: v. 拉拢；利用；补选填补（空缺）

scenes.sentence: The ruling party attempted to co-opt the opposition leader by offering him a cabinet position.
scenes.translation: 执政党试图通过向反对党领袖提供内阁职位来拉拢他。

scenes.sentence: To reduce resistance to change, management decided to co-opt key employees into the decision-making process.
scenes.translation: 为了减少变革的阻力，管理层决定让关键员工参与决策过程。

scenes.sentence: The cop asked me for my ID.
scenes.translation: 警察让我出示身份证。

nodes.name: cope
nodes.meaning: v. 应对，处理；克服困难

scenes.sentence: It took him a while to cope with the stress of the new job.
scenes.translation: 他花了一段时间才适应新工作的压力。

scenes.sentence: She is learning how to cope with her grief after the loss.
scenes.translation: 她正在学习如何在失去亲人后应对悲痛。

nodes.name: copy
nodes.meaning: v. 复制；抄袭 n. 副本；复印件

scenes.sentence: Please do not copy your classmates' homework.
scenes.translation: 请不要抄袭你同学的作业。

scenes.sentence: You can copy and paste the text into another document.
scenes.translation: 你可以将文本复制并粘贴到另一个文档中。

nodes.name: corkscrew
nodes.meaning: n. 开瓶器 v. 用开瓶器打开

scenes.sentence: Could you pass me the corkscrew so I can open this bottle of wine?
scenes.translation: 你能把开瓶器递给我，让我打开这瓶酒吗？

scenes.sentence: The old corkscrew was rusty and difficult to use.
scenes.translation: 那个旧开瓶器生锈了，很难用。

nodes.name: corporation
nodes.meaning: n. 公司；企业；法人团体

scenes.sentence: The multinational corporation has expanded its operations to over fifty countries.
scenes.translation: 这家跨国公司已经将其业务扩展到五十多个国家。

scenes.sentence: Shareholders often attend the annual meeting to vote on major decisions made by the corporation.
scenes.translation: 股东们通常参加年度会议，对由董事会做出的重大决策进行投票。

scenes.sentence: They moved to a small cottage near the lake last year.
scenes.translation: 他们去年搬到了湖边的一间小村舍。

scenes.sentence: The cottage has a beautiful garden and is very quiet.
scenes.translation: 这所小屋有一个漂亮的花园，非常安静。

scenes.sentence: The doctor asked if I had a persistent cough.
scenes.translation: 医生问我是否有持续的咳嗽。

scenes.sentence: He couldn't stop coughing because of the smoke.
scenes.translation: 因为烟雾，他不停地咳嗽。

scenes.sentence: Could you help me, please?
scenes.translation: 请你能帮我一下吗？

scenes.sentence: It could rain later today.
scenes.translation: 今天晚些时候可能会下雨。

nodes.name: couple
nodes.meaning: n. 一对；夫妇；几个 v. 结合；连接

scenes.translation: 这对幸福的夫妇刚刚庆祝了他们的结婚十周年纪念日。

scenes.sentence: There are only a couple of books left on the shelf.
scenes.translation: 书架上只剩下几本书了。

scenes.sentence: The two companies decided to couple their resources for the new project.
scenes.translation: 两家公司决定为新项目联合利用资源。

nodes.name: court
nodes.meaning: n. 法庭；法院；球场；庭院

scenes.sentence: The defendant stood silent in the court.
scenes.translation: 被告在法庭上保持沉默。

scenes.sentence: They played tennis on the outdoor court.
scenes.translation: 他们在室外球场上打网球。

nodes.name: crab
nodes.meaning: n. 螃蟹；脾气暴躁的人

scenes.sentence: We saw a small crab scuttling across the wet sand near the water.
scenes.translation: 我们看到一只小螃蟹在水边的湿沙子上横着爬。

scenes.sentence: Don't be such a crab; just tell us what you want.
scenes.translation: 别这么脾气暴躁，直接告诉我们你想要什么。

nodes.name: crack
nodes.meaning: v. 破裂; 发出裂帛声 n. 裂缝; 破裂声

scenes.sentence: The window cracked when the ball hit it.
scenes.translation: 球击中窗户时，窗户裂了。

scenes.sentence: Her voice cracked with emotion.
scenes.translation: 她的声音因激动而颤抖/变调。

nodes.name: crackdown
nodes.meaning: n. 镇压；打击；严厉的处罚

scenes.scene: 政府采取严厉措施打击犯罪
scenes.sentence: The government has announced a strict crackdown on illegal gambling operations.
scenes.translation: 政府宣布对非法赌博活动进行严厉打击。

scenes.scene: 对环境污染的整治行动
scenes.sentence: Environmental agencies are launching a crackdown on factories that violate emission standards.
scenes.translation: 环保机构正在发起对违反排放标准的工厂的整治行动。

scenes.sentence: He is crazy about football.
scenes.translation: 他对足球着迷。

scenes.sentence: It's crazy to drive so fast.
scenes.translation: 开那么快太疯狂了。

nodes.name: crash
nodes.meaning: v. 碰撞；坠毁；破产 n. 撞击声； crashes 计算机死机

scenes.translation: 那辆汽车在暴风雨中撞到了树上。

scenes.sentence: My computer crashed while I was saving the document.
scenes.translation: 我保存文档时电脑死机了。

scenes.sentence: The stock market crashed in 2008.
scenes.translation: 2008年股市崩盘。

scenes.sentence: The workers loaded the wooden crate onto the truck for shipment.
scenes.translation: 工人们将木箱装上卡车以便运输。

scenes.sentence: She bought a crate of apples from the local market.
scenes.translation: 她从当地市场买了一箱苹果。

nodes.name: crawl
nodes.meaning: v. 爬行; 缓慢行进

scenes.sentence: The baby began to crawl across the carpet.
scenes.translation: 婴儿开始在地毯上爬行。

scenes.sentence: Traffic was crawling along the highway due to the accident.
scenes.translation: 由于事故，高速公路上的车辆行驶缓慢。

scenes.sentence: Schools should encourage creativity rather than just memorizing facts.
scenes.translation: 学校应该鼓励创造力，而不仅仅是死记硬背事实。

scenes.sentence: The company values creativity and innovation in its product design.
scenes.translation: 该公司重视产品设计中的创造力和创新。

nodes.name: crew

scenes.translation: 机组人员确保所有乘客安全就座。

scenes.translation: 学生应该明白偷窃是一种犯罪行为，并可能导致严重的后果。

scenes.translation: 警方正在调查一起涉及非法毒品交易的大案。

scenes.translation: 由于油价突然下跌，该国正面临严重的经济危机。

scenes.translation: 失业后，他经历了一段个人危机。

nodes.name: critic
nodes.meaning: n. 批评家；评论家；批评者

scenes.translation: 注意不要对朋友的选择做出过于严厉的批评。

scenes.translation: 教授对该理论的批判性分析揭示了几个逻辑缺陷。

scenes.translation: 我们处于项目的关键阶段，需要更多资金。

scenes.translation: 教授对该研究中使用的研究方法进行了批判性分析。

scenes.translation: 病人的病情变得危急，医生们正在密切监控他的状况。

nodes.name: crop

scenes.translation: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看表演。

scenes.translation: 游客在假期涌入博物馆。

scenes.translation: 把野生动物关在小笼子里是一种残忍的行为。

scenes.translation: 残酷的冬风使旅程变得极其艰难。

nodes.name: cruise

scenes.translation: 我们决定去加勒比海进行一次为期一周的巡航旅行。

scenes.translation: 这艘船将以20节的速度巡航。

nodes.name: crush

scenes.translation: 高中时，她非常迷恋她的数学老师。

scenes.translation: 榨汁时小心不要把葡萄压碎。

scenes.translation: 体育场里挤满了兴奋的球迷，等待着音乐会开始。

scenes.translation: 手术后，他不得不依靠拐杖在房间里行走。

scenes.translation: 批评者认为，政府补贴是对低效行业的拐杖式扶持。

scenes.translation: 立方体有六个正方形面。

scenes.translation: 他把奶酪切成小块立方体。

scenes.translation: 一立方米的体积等于1000升。

scenes.translation: 他们买了一个立方体盒子来存放玩具。

scenes.translation: 她在等待开始发言的信号。

scenes.translation: 导演给了演员们入场的信号。

nodes.name: cuff

scenes.translation: 那架古董钢琴太笨重了，搬不上狭窄的楼梯。

scenes.translation: 他是个精明的商人，总能找到增加利润的方法。

scenes.translation: 她从橱柜里拿出一个盘子。

scenes.translation: 她在会议期间试图抑制自己的愤怒。

scenes.translation: 政府计划通过提高利率来控制通货膨胀。

scenes.translation: 好奇心是科学发现和创新的原动力。

scenes.translation: 孩子的好奇心驱使他探索老房子的每一个角落。
